items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-08-06
items.q: But Jack did come to San Antonio when I'd given up the band with Freddie Coleman's little band at the first keyhole nightclub that I had.

ctx.x: Sometimes they were in it with the sweetheart. Sometimes they were in it.

That's right. Sometimes they were with somebody else. He said, I remember who you're with. Turn around through him and look in her face and call him Sweetheart. See, they don't like it. Okay. But they do it too. At the keyhole. That was at the keyhole. Jack Willis.
Telephone. No, it's not Jack Willis.
